data.description: A xill can shift from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane as a move action. Shifting from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane takes 2 consecutive full-round actions, during which time the xill is immobile. As a xill fades away, it becomes harder to hit: opponents have a 20%% miss chance in the first round and a 50%% miss chance in the second. A xill can take a single willing or helpless creature with it when it switches planes.
